bok.text: Toshi Umezawa is in Michiko's employ and beholden to the Myojin of Night's Reach as the Kami War threatens Kamigawa, and he goes to the Heart of Frost, gains the Yuki-Onna's frost power and captures her in a magic disk.
He persuades Hidetsugu to attack Jukai before razing Minamo and Otawara, and he goes through the Shadow Gate to barter with Night's Reach for teleportation power.
At Eiganjo, Toshi grabs That Which Was Taken, which makes O-Kagachi disappear, then freezes Mochi and drops the Taken One at his feet, hoping that Konda, O-Kagachi and Hidetsugu will fight over it.
Night's Reach calls in Toshi's debt and has him leave the Hyozan Reckoners, though his intentions secretly diverge from hers.
